description: Free open-source drum studio. Application only — no samples included.

sources.name: EZdrummer 3
sources.acquisition: Official 10-day trial or purchase via Toontrack account + Product Manager
sources.notes: Core library ships with EZdrummer 3. EZX expansions and legacy EZD1/2 core convert to EZX format after registration.

sources.name: EZdrummer 2
sources.acquisition: Legacy install — samples readable from Sounds folders on disk
sources.notes: WAV samples and MIDI grooves are stored locally under the install directory.

sources.name: Cakewalk Drum Replacer
sources.acquisition: Bundled with Cakewalk by BandLab — samples in SFZ + WAV format
sources.notes: 768 WAV samples across 4 kits. SFZ maps velocity layers and GM MIDI notes. MIDI Library includes Groove Monkee (705 grooves).
